newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Kuala Lumpur key share index falls below 1,000 pts.
newsitem.headline: Kuala Lumpur key share index falls below 1,000 pts.

text.p: The Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's key index fell to a new 1-1/2 year low by falling below 1,000 points in early trading.
At 0142 GMT, the Composite Index of 100 large capitalised issues was down 9.49 points or 0.94 percent at 999.03.
Extended falls in blue chip issues pushed the index below the psychological support level of 1,000 points, despite having fallen 4.71 percent in the last two days.
Maybank, Tenaga, Telekom, Sime Darby and Petronas Gas -- among the five biggest-capitalised stocks -- were down between 10 cents and 40 cents.
